تستوضحون (form X)
# تَسْتَوْضِحُونَ (tastawḍiḥūna) /tas.taw.dˤi.ħuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَوْضَحَ (istawḍaḥa)
# تُسْتَوْضَحُونَ (tustawḍaḥūna) /tus.taw.dˤa.ħuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَوْضَحَ (istawḍaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
